The image features a massive parabolic dish antenna constructed from an intricate lattice of metal beams and mesh, rather than solid panels. A heavy rectangular receiver housing sits atop the dish structure, supported by a truss framework. To the right, a boxy equipment cabin is attached to the side of the mount. The background shows a cloudy sky and a dark treeline at the bottom, indicating an outdoor installation.
